info.description: Sections 6.2 and 6.4 plus the conflict rules of 5.10. Needs the seed data (Section 8) and Danial's /venues and /approvals endpoints. Run folder 0 first, then the others in order, with the Collection Runner. Set testPassword in the environment to your SEED_PASSWORD.
